title: aquilegia vulgaris subsp. oxysepala
intro: Aquilegia vulgaris subsp. oxysepala, commonly known as the red columbine or fern-leaved columbine, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Aquilegia vulgaris subsp. oxysepala are attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, have been identified as contributing to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
